page:info.page:name: Main Menu (Home)
page:info.page:function: Hero section with Create Game and View Saved Sessions buttons
Choose one of the 3 games: Snakes & Ladders, Classroom Bingo, Card Matching
Resume the active session (shown when a game is in progress)

page:everyPage.page:function: Top navigation bar: Home / Dashboard, Create Game, Saved Sessions, How to Play, Day / Night theme, TH / EN language, Log In or account name
Taskbar: Start menu, Back, Desktop, Explorer, New Session, Aa font sample, sound on / off, hide bar

page:info.page:name: Login / Register (and Account Profile)
page:info.page:function: Log In tab: username and password with a show / hide button
Register tab: full name, username, password and confirm password (username at least 3 characters, password at least 4)
After login the Teacher Dashboard opens; sessions are then saved in the database
When logged in this page shows the Account Profile: name, member since, last login
Log Out with confirmation (back to Guest Mode)
Delete Account: asks for the password and deletes the account and all its data

page:info.page:name: Teacher Dashboard
page:info.page:function: Counters: total sessions, in progress, completed
Quick actions: Create Game, Saved Sessions, How to Play, Resume Latest Game
Recent sessions: Continue Playing (in progress) or View Scoreboard (completed)

page:info.page:name: Saved Sessions
page:info.page:access: Everyone (guest sessions are deleted after 24 hours)
page:info.page:function: Guest Mode banner: data is deleted after 24 hours, time left, Log In link
Search by session title or subject
Filter tabs: All, In Progress, Completed
Session card: Continue Playing (in progress) opens /game/{sessionId}
Session card: View Scoreboard (completed) opens /scoreboard/{sessionId}
Session card: Restart Game and Delete, each with a confirmation window (UI-12)
Backup (JSON) downloads all sessions; Import loads a JSON backup

page:subpage.page:name: Game Screen
page:subpage.page:function: Toolbar: Back, Split / Fullscreen view, Restart Game, Save / End Game, Delete
Timer: pause / resume, +1 minute, reset; Game Time Is Up banner with +1 Minute or Save / End Game (UI-07)
Question panel: question, Show Answer, previous / next question, choose the first hand-raised team, Correct / Incorrect (UI-06)
Projector Mode: the question in full screen for the class
Board: Classroom Bingo tile claiming (UI-08), Snakes & Ladders dice and moves (UI-09), Card Matching pairs (UI-10)
Pop-up Save Session or End Game (UI-13): Save Session keeps the game in progress and opens /sessions; Save and End Game completes it
Pop-up Victory Celebration (UI-14): winner, or DRAW with co-champions; View Scoreboard or Return to Menu

page:subpage.page:name: Scoreboard & Report
page:subpage.page:function: Match outcome: Winner or DRAW / Co-Champions
Overview: top team, class accuracy, total points, time played
Podium and standings with standard competition ranking (1, 1, 3) and Tie tags
Correct, incorrect and total score of every team
Score chart and event timeline with a team filter
Export CSV (UTF-8 with BOM) and Print Report

page:info.page:name: Create Session Wizard
page:info.page:function: Step 1 Game Setup: session title, subject, game, Quick or Standard board, time limit (5, 10, 15, 20 or 1–120 minutes)
Step 2 Teams & Roster: 2 to 6 teams and the student names of each team
Step 3 Questions: load sample questions, add, edit or delete questions with points, answer and category
Save to Saved Sessions, or Create & Start Game (opens /game/{sessionId})

page:info.page:name: How to Play
page:info.page:function: Rules of Classroom Bingo, Snakes & Ladders and Card Matching
Steps for the teacher: create, judge answers, finish and export
